violations.text: Staff and PIC were not knowledgeable of how to disassemble and adequately clean and sanitize the slicer. Inspector, staff, and PIC disassembled slicer together; staff cleaned and sanitized disassembled slicer during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/18/2026

Raw animal foods (eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (cooked chicken) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. New Violation. Correct By: 11/18/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Staff cleaned and sanitized during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/18/2026

Chopped lettuce, cabbage, and pre-portioned vegetable garnish dishes, and containers of soaking glass noodles were observed held at 56-64 degrees Fahrenheit on the counter. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC instructed staff to place all items in refrigeration during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/18/2026

The concentration of the sanitizer solution for the wet wiping cloths was in excess of 200 parts per million (ppm). The required concentration for chlorine sanitizer is 50-100 ppm. Bucket was emptied and refilled to proper concentration during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/18/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets on prep unit were observed in poor repair. Sugar bucket observed with a cracked rim. New Violation. Correct By: 12/30/2026

The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the dish machine, 3-bay sink, and sani buckets. Inspector provided test strips during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/18/2026
One light under ventilation hood was non-functional at the time of this inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 02/18/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2025

Raw animal foods (fish, eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (vegetables, cooked foods) in the prep unit and reach-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. PIC relocated foods during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2025

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was in excess of 200 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Technician was contacted during inspection and informed inspector that he is in process of obtaining a part and will return to establishment to adjust concentration. PIC asked dish washer to cease use of dish machine until further notice. New Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2025

The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was 0 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 200 ppm. 3-bay sink was set-up with chlorine during inspection. Technician was contacted during inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2025

Working containers of spices are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. PIC had staff label during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2025
Containers of food were observed stored on the floor in the dry storage area. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2025
Rice was being prepared (in rice cooker) in an unapproved food preparation area (storage room). PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2025
The following were observed in poor repair: -rice cooker (control held with tape) -Prep unit door (held with tape) -Refrigerator door gaskets. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2025
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the dish machine. Inspector provided. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2025

The condensate from the roof units is draining into the 3-bay sink. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain. Line was temporarily moved to a container. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2025
The grease receptacle and the area surrounding the receptacle has an accumulation of grease. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2025

The floors under shelving in the dry storage area and under the ice machine have an accumulation of debris and old droppings. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2025
